consensus_findings.description: Revision 6 closes every reproduced contract blocker: schema-version numeric parity now matches Draft 2020-12 and JavaScript while rejecting booleans/strings, Python and TypeScript composite validators agree on W3C/arithmetic/bounds behavior, Unicode maxLength uses code points, and every SQL correlation table rejects zero identifiers.

The approved plan now provides an implementation-ready universal observability architecture with bounded durable PostgreSQL correlation, mandatory semantic context validation, full entrypoint coverage, fail-closed GX-10 egress, retention/recovery policy, a valid package DAG, and measurable end-to-end acceptance evidence.
